forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email, and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.label: Email address
forgot.sentBody: If {{email}} has an account here, a link to reset your password is on its way.
forgot.tip: The link works once. Nothing after a minute? Look in your spam folder, or send it again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Use one you don't use anywhere else.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password in both.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. You've been signed out everywhere else.
reset.expiredBody: It may have been used already, or it's expired. Ask for a new one.
